objective: mean Macro F1 over 3-fold GroupKFold by trip, every 8th fix of the 80 train trips

ranges.num_leaves: 15-255 (log): tree complexity; 63 untuned, both simpler and richer trees tried
ranges.learning_rate: 0.01-0.2 (log): step size; smaller needs more trees
ranges.min_child_samples: 10-300 (log): minimum rows per leaf; larger = smoother, less overfitting
ranges.subsample: 0.5-1.0: share of rows per tree (bagging), reduces variance
ranges.colsample_bytree: 0.5-1.0: share of features per tree, decorrelates trees
